public_rationale: The dated launch records place all three products in an overlapping assistant category, but that is weaker than practical equivalence. They also describe particular capabilities and integrations whose importance depends on the user's tasks. The verified records do not provide a matched comparison of performance, complete features, prices and limits sufficient to support or contradict the ordinary reading.
limitations: Basically the same permits differences, so finding any difference would not automatically refute the claim.
The evidence consists of vendor descriptions rather than a complete comparative evaluation.
The unspecified other LLMs cannot be exhaustively assessed.

statement.excerpt: ChatGPT is basically the same product as Claude or Grok or any number of different LLMs.
statement.document_title: How To Argue With An AI Booster

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is practical substitutability for common assistant tasks, not identical models, source code or outputs.
The surrounding discussion makes capability, supported tasks and comparable consumer pricing relevant. Merely belonging to the chatbot category is insufficient.
The named comparators are Claude and Grok; the unspecified other LLMs are not treated as a universal claim about every language model.
For this ongoing product-state observation, the target is the current calendar quarter through publication, July 1–August 25, 2025. Only offerings available by publication count.
No numerical benchmark tolerance or evaluator-selected weighting of features is treated as something Zitron committed to.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous product records and comparisons show that ChatGPT, Claude and Grok are practical substitutes across ordinary assistant tasks at broadly comparable consumer tiers, with differences that do not materially change those uses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous comparisons demonstrate material differences in supported ordinary tasks, practical performance, access or cost that prevent the claimed broad substitutability.

evidence.explanation: The launch record documents ChatGPT's coding tasks and broader assistant positioning. It does not establish equivalent results, access or prices across the three products.
Claude offered research and analysis functions in the same broad assistant category. The vendor description does not measure practical equivalence with ChatGPT or Grok.

Grok's search and tool use overlap with the assistant category while emphasizing a particular integration. This does not by itself establish that rivals lack an adequate substitute or that the products are practically equivalent.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A reproducible comparison of the August 2025 versions and comparable consumer tiers across common tasks, supported features, prices and usage limits, showing whether material differences prevent practical substitution.
